vars.content: a second court, the Hollow Ring: id hollow_ring, its name under the key COURT_HOLLOW_RING in i18n/strings.csv, 1200 by 640 like the first, in data/courts.json after the Cinder Pit (so it is played in the second round and every other one after), with at least three pillars in data/walls.json and four spawns in data/spawns.json. Fair spawns: each clear of the pillars, at least 300 pixels from every other, and none in sight of another (the line between any two blocked by a pillar). Bot matches played on it alone (ArenaServer with only that court, seeds 1 to 4) must each end within 150 seconds of play

vars.problem: the architecture runner fails with an error in game/court_view.gd (per-frame-lookup)

vars.report: their volume and language are back to the defaults after the update. The previous version saved user://settings.json as {"volume_db": <decibels, 0 for full volume>, "language": <locale>}, sometimes with "version": 1, and kept no record of matches
when someone leaves a match, their glimmer stays in the pit, standing still: anyone can shoot it for free, it keeps rounds going, and no bot ever takes the empty place

vars.goal: a title menu as the main scene res://main.tscn (root Main) with Menu/PlayButton, Menu/HostButton, Menu/JoinButton, Menu/SettingsButton and Menu/QuitButton, where Play adds the game scene res://game/game.tscn as a child of Main named Game for a local match against bots, and Join adds a child of Main named Join with Box/AddressEdit (127.0.0.1 to start with), Box/JoinButton and Box/BackButton back to the menu; pause: Escape or the game's HUD/PauseButton shows its PauseMenu node (a CanvasLayer with ResumeButton and QuitButton) and pauses a local match, ResumeButton hides it and resumes; playing over ENet through a NetSession node (game/net_session.gd, class_name NetSession: host(port) -> Error, serve(server: ArenaServer, link: SimLink = null), join(address, port, client: ArenaClient = null) -> Error and close()), so a hosted match takes players who join and gives their slot back to a bot when they leave; a dedicated server: with --server, or --soak-role=server and --soak-port=N as the kit's soak starts it, the main scene runs headless match after match on the port and prints [soak] ready, and --soak-role=client joins it with a bot playing; settings (volume and language) saved by a SettingsStore class (scripts/settings_store.gd) in user://settings.json; and a data.json for the kit's data runner covering data/courts.json, data/walls.json and data/spawns.json
